Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MOSAIC 1.1.0

  • run_DC_test() permutes condition labels across samples and tests each feature against its own null distribution. New arguments blocks (permute within blocks, e.g. donors in a paired design), n_perm and max_exact (exact enumeration when the number of assignments is small). Results are returned as a data frame with pseudo-F, R2, P-value and BH-adjusted P-value.
  • calculate_empirical_pvalue() is deprecated; use run_DC_test().
  • New compute_feature_similarity() for per-feature sample similarity matrices.
  • find_elbow_kneedle() returns at least 2.
  • Analysis scripts for the paper are in reproducibility/.

MOSAIC 1.0.0

  • Initial release.
